citycare_hospitals.summary: Comprehensive web and mobile solution for CityCare Hospitals enabling multi-speciality doctor appointment booking, real-time availability tracking, online consultation fee collection, automated SMS/email alerts, and administrative analytics handling 2,000 daily bookings with HIPAA-compliant data security.

requirements.text: Patient registration and authentication using phone OTP and email verification
Doctor directory search filtered by speciality, hospital branch, consultation fee, and geolocation
Real-time doctor calendar slot availability engine with concurrency lock during checkout
Appointment scheduling, instant cancellation, and patient rescheduling workflows
Payment gateway integration (UPI, cards, netbanking) with automated refunds on cancellation
Automated transactional SMS and email notification service for appointment confirmations and reminders
Doctor portal for dynamic consultation hours, leave management, and daily appointment roster
Hospital administration dashboard with booking analytics, doctor occupancy, and revenue reconciliation
Scalable architecture supporting peak throughput of 2,000 daily bookings without latency degradation
Patient health data encryption at rest and in transit with role-based access audit logs

gaps: No specification on patient Electronic Health Record (EHR) integration standard (e.g. ABDM / HL7 FHIR)
conflicts: Instant cancellation policy conflicts with payment gateway settlement SLA (T+2 days) for direct refunds

risks.title: Payment Gateway Concurrency & Double Booking
risks.mitigation: Implement distributed Redis reservation locks on appointment slots with a 10-minute hold expiry

risks.title: SMS/Email Delivery Failures during Network Outages
risks.mitigation: Deploy asynchronous background message queue with exponential backoff retry

risks.title: Patient Data Regulatory Non-Compliance
risks.mitigation: Enforce field-level encryption for PII and enable comprehensive audit logging for all record views

milestones.name: Admin Portal, Security Auditing & Load Testing

retail_shop.summary: Preliminary requirement outline for an omnichannel retail store requesting an online e-commerce shop with offline in-store POS synchronization, modern UI, and quick checkout.

requirements.text: Online product catalog with search, categorization, and pricing
Offline client-side operation with local data caching
Bidirectional inventory sync between offline POS and central cloud database
Payment processing supporting card swipe and online UPI

gaps: No delivery deadline specified by client
No defined maximum or minimum budget envelope
Offline sync conflict resolution strategy (last-write-wins vs FIFO) is completely unspecified
Specific competitor feature benchmarks are undefined
conflicts: Online real-time payment validation directly conflicts with offline-first disconnected sales requirements

risks.title: Inventory Overselling under Offline Disconnection
risks.mitigation: Define safety stock buffers and strict offline credit limits per store terminal

risks.title: Unbounded Project Scope due to Ambiguous Requirements
risks.mitigation: Hold formal requirements discovery workshop to fix MVP scope and freeze deadline

risks.title: Offline Data Sync Data Corruption
risks.mitigation: Implement CRDTs (Conflict-free Replicated Data Types) or event-sourcing audit log
